# Labels for every released image, loaded by the release job in
# .github/workflows/pipeline.yml together with <component>.txt. They override
# the labels inherited from the UBI / Iron Bank base. Inherited labels cannot be
# removed, so the Red Hat and Iron Bank ones that would describe the image as
# theirs are set empty; com.redhat.license_terms stays as the EULA pointer.
# The OCI version, created and revision labels come from docker/metadata-action.
